name: js-retry
instruction: Implement retry.js (CommonJS): module.exports = retry. retry(fn, {attempts=3, onRetry}) calls the SYNCHRONOUS fn() and returns its value. On a thrown error it retries until `attempts` TOTAL calls have been made, then rethrows the LAST error. onRetry(error, attemptNumber) is called before each retry only — never before the first call, never after the final failure. attempts must be a positive integer or RangeError. A successful call stops immediately.
verifyCmd: node -e "const r=require('./retry.js');let n=0;const v=r(()=>{n++;if(n<3)throw new Error('x');return 'ok'},{attempts:3});if(v!=='ok'||n!==3){console.error('retry count',n);process.exit(1)}let calls=0,notes=[];try{r(()=>{calls++;throw new Error('boom'+calls)},{attempts:2,onRetry:(e,a)=>notes.push(a)});console.error('should rethrow');process.exit(1)}catch(e){if(e.message!=='boom2'){console.error('last error',e.message);process.exit(1)}}if(calls!==2){console.error('total calls',calls);process.exit(1)}if(notes.length!==1||notes[0]!==1){console.error('onRetry pattern',JSON.stringify(notes));process.exit(1)}let once=0;r(()=>{once++;return 1},{attempts:5});if(once!==1){console.error('stop on success');process.exit(1)}try{r(()=>1,{attempts:0});console.error('no throw');process.exit(1)}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof RangeError))process.exit(1)}console.log('ok')"
